caption.text: Part 2 of BASH TRAPS & SIGNALS. Your script creates a temp dir, then dies to Ctrl-C — and leaves the mess behind. This handbook is the full field guide to Bash traps: EXIT vs ERR vs INT, why double quotes in a trap string freeze the wrong value, how an unquoted `$tmpdir` turns cleanup into `rm -rf /`, and the two-phase TERM-then-KILL pattern for children that spawn children.
